summary_markdown: A discussion occurred regarding the data loading and synchronization of multiple session aggregation tables (specifically `device_session_agg_ml_2`, `device_session_agg_4`, and `device_session_agg_5`). [p1] inquired if running a new copying script, after dropping existing beta data, would correctly populate all three specified tables from production to the beta environment. [me] confirmed that the script copies data for all three listed tables.
decisions: The copy script will populate `device_session_agg_ml_2`, `device_session_agg_4`, and `device_session_agg_5`.
